title: Domain part of Stacks Tag 037D.
statement: For a filtered diagram of commutative rings whose localizations at all contracted primes are domains, the localization of the colimit at any prime is a domain.

source.place: Stacks Project, Algebra, Lemma Tag 037D (lemma-colimit-normal-ring), stated there for a directed system; a filtered colimit is a directed colimit by Categories, Lemma Tag 0032 (categories-lemma-directed-category-system). Used in More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 06DI.

proof.text: The assertion follows by the common-stage lifting argument for filtered colimits, clearing denominators (domain case) or lifting a monic relation (integral-closedness case).
